BiblicalUsage: Malkiram was a son of Jeconiah, named once, in 1 Chronicles 3:18, in the royal line carried into Babylon. He is one of the sons of Jeconiah listed in the genealogy of the exiled kings.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name in the exile's genealogy is a thread of hope: the line of David went on, even in Babylon.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
